svg.title: TOPAK A4 — One orientation, eighteen layers: toward more authority is consensus, toward less is local
svg.desc: Every boundary in the design is asymmetric in the same direction. Crossing toward more authority needs consensus, an issuance or a fresh grant; crossing toward less is local and monotone, needs no quorum, and is attributed. The boundary register found it stated five times in five vocabularies; ToO rev 16 §7.8 states it at eighteen layers, two of them new at rev 15 and none at rev 16. At the pattern level it inverts.

The boundary register found it stated five times in five vocabularies; ToO rev 16 §7.8 states it at eighteen layers, two of them new at rev 15 and none at rev 16. At the

svg.text: "Every boundary above is asymmetric in the same direction: crossing toward more authority requires consensus, crossing toward less is local and
monotone."
"This is not a boundary: it is the orientation of all of them, and it is stated five times in five vocabularies across the current corpus."

text.tspan: Five vocabularies in 2026.09.13; eighteen layers at

svg.text: grants versus denials
subtraction from the floor
parse failure is a deny
rung subtraction
findings may deny, never admit

The five are the register's own wording. ToO §7.8 keeps decision, policy and deployment as rows, has no syntax or semantic row of its own, and adds fifteen: change, authority, evidence, credential, confinement,
lineage, time, seat, detection, bundle and trusted base, at rev 14 ingress and operation, and at rev 15 workflow and evidence of proof. Rev 16 adds no row and changes none (Appendix L).

The Statement column is §7.8 verbatim, and so is Source, with confirmation markers added (C1–C4: author-ratified until confirmed; provisional: in force and subject to redesign, ADR-0029 A4). The two direction columns are this diagram's reading of each row, drawn from the sections cited in them (§ alone means ToO rev 16). Ingress and Operation are new at rev 14 (Appendix J), Workflow and Evidence of proof at rev 15
(Appendix K); rev 16 leaves the table as it was (Appendix L).

text.tspan: ↑ Toward more authority: what it costs
↓ Toward less authority: what it takes

svg.text: Consensus for grants, local for denials
A grant is an admit, consensus-ordered in the Paxos log (ADR-0015)
A denial is not ordered: absence of effect is not an event (ADR-0015)
Established
Bundles only subtract from the floor — by composition, for every bundle
No bundle path at all; the floor itself moves by promotion, and a relaxation adds an anchor issuance (§3.2)
Any bundle, at any age, can only narrow: admit ⟺ floor_permit ∧ ¬bundle_deny
Authority-increasing changes need consensus; decreasing ones need no quorum, are attributed,
and are ordered when they change replicated state
Consensus
No quorum; attributed; ordered only when replicated state changes (revocation, expiry, end of round)
Floor-rollout session; ADR-0033 §4
Degenerate forms lose theorems, never gain capability
A variation with a capability the archetype lacks fails admission: the archetype is incomplete (§8.1)
A degeneracy loses premises and theorems, and carries a declaration record
Relaxing rules needs the anchor; operating within them does not
An anchor issuance and a promotion (rules-floor changes: both keys in both directions, §7.3)
Operate and subtract under the last resident rules; anchor loss freezes change, never operation
Authority facts survive erasure and break-glass
Removing a forensic class is a floor relaxation (§4.4)
F1–F6 are denials on the erasure envelope: bundles can only narrow erasure further
Renewal only narrows and keeps the rung; widening needs a fresh grant after the round ends
A fresh grant, once the round has ended: at most one live lease per principal
Renewal narrows the alphabet or shortens the TTL; it keeps bundle, round, role and rung
ADR-0031, A1 C1; C2 for A1
A principal below the declared rung is refused, never granted lower; every host failure the
archetype tolerates subtracts
A grant only on an Attested verdict at the deployment's declared rung
Unattestable refuses; Contested refuses and revokes the principal; no silent downgrade
The projection over-approximates what a round could read, and adding to it can only fail a pair
Independence passes only on upper-bound shares, at the promotion tally and the declaration
Charging a round with more corpus can only fail a pair
ADR-0035 (Proposed)
An interval whose failure subtracts may use a local clock; one whose failure preserves authority
needs trusted time
Persona expiry: trusted time from outside the principal (A6). A break-glass grant no longer needs it: it ends
with its round (§3.3; R8 withdrawn)
Lease expiry, passive e-stop, vote timeout: a local monotonic clock, margin erring early
Only a thinker seat is issued a variant that writes, runs or offers; adding a seat to a cell never
adds authority
Draft, Invoke, Submit, Actuate only for a thinker seat, and Actuate for an emergency seat
(ADR-0037 A3, provisional): floor forbid B10
An observer or grant seat reads, emits and votes or denies; an operator seat holds no authoring
variant (ADR-0037 A4); adding one adds no variant
Observers combine by any-of, and coupling only refuses: more Observers never lower safety,
and an absent one stalls
None: a finding is deny-only and never an admit precondition (ADR-0007); no Observer quorum
A finding from any member of W(p) takes effect; a dead or slow Observer stops its own Thinker
A bundle loads only under an issued key's signature; a file name is evidence of nothing
Replacing the bundle key is an anchor issuance (ADR-0025 §1 (f))
No verifying signature, no load; an empty key set loads nothing and denies
A component enters only if its failure can only subtract, or its identity is issued; what can add and
is fixed by nothing is refused
A row that can add enters only as a trust root with an issued identity; adding a row is a relaxation with its
own record
A delegated row's failure only subtracts and needs no proof, key or quorum; removing a row is a tightening
Suppression only subtracts, and the label forbids are monotone in what was read: delivering
more in the clear can only refuse more
A bundle may move every label to clear, and buys a narrower round: clearSet grows and R5–R7 refuse
A handle in place of the bytes keeps clearSet small; a suppressed item's bytes do not enter the guest
A quorum seats; one operator keeps a quorum's grant going and may narrow it, never widen it; a
deny needs no lease and no peer
A first lease needs a quorum: a promotion of a seating or an anchor issuance; an operator's add needs a
live lease and a live peer (§7.10)
EndRound, Revoke: a live lease or a fresh sign-on, in its own domain; FenceEpoch: a live lease (§7.10)
ADR-0050 (provisional) C1, C3, C4
The orchestrator only selects among edges already enabled; a guard's value can change only
towards disabled; a route that fails the re-check at apply is void
Every lease in a workflow is its promotion's grant, voted on with the graph and the seatings; a mesh's
promotion grants at most its budget (§2.11)
The orchestrator chooses only among enabled edges; a finding, revocation or fence voids a route at apply;
a lapsed orchestrator takes no default edge (§2.11)
ADR-0054, ADR-0055 (Proposed)
A second derivation adds evidence and changes no claim: a Lean result is cited beside the
TLAPS proof, and the premise table carries it as a derived premise
A stage of the refinement chain discharged through Lean needs an ADR-0033 addendum, and none may
cite one until the table can say "either proof" (ADR-0053 §5)
A Lean result is cited beside the TLAPS proof; T-0045-31's residual does not move and no claim widens

text.tspan: At the pattern level it inverts

svg.text: Every conformant deployment goes into declaration debt (§7.8): what it ran as the archetype is now a degeneracy it must
declare.
Published theorems are voided (§7.8): a property checked against the old archetype stops holding of it.
Nothing bounds how the archetype grows: the archetype-evolution record (versioning, the dominance rule, non-increasing TCB) is
unwritten (§8.2; G12 item 7, as at G11).

text.tspan: Where the orientation is not yet whole
Break-glass ends with its round, on a provisional record

svg.text: Register §7.3: a non-expiring grant broke the monotone story. Now a grant is one lease of an
emergency seating and ends with its round; R8 is withdrawn (ADR-0026 W1; §3.3, §10; G10
item 8).
X1's retirement is in force on ADR-0052, provisional: if it is redesigned, break-glass has no
settled form until the redesign is ratified (G12 §1.2, §8, as at G11).
Coupling separates a present Observer from an absent one, not an honest one from a colluding
one: every fact it reads is the Observer's own assertion (§5.4).
An emergency seat is not a thinker and is not coupled (ADR-0039 A2; G10 item 49). Operators
observe each other by presence, not by anything read; detection still fails open against a colluding
Observer (G12 §8).
Lineage rests on ADR-0035, Proposed and unrevised since G11 (G12 §2.4); Workflow on
ADR-0054 and ADR-0055, Proposed, which the reference already follows on a floor stage not in
force (G12 item 102). Their modules are proved since 2026.11.11 (Workflow_proof,
Mesh_proof; R7, R3), and that does not ratify them (G12 §8, item 101).
Every other row cites Accepted (genesis) records or an established principle; most of those
records carry confirmation markers and are author-ratified (§0).

text.tspan: A row on a provisional record

svg.text: Operation rests on ADR-0050, provisional: its centre, a first lease from a quorum, is not built. At
the reference an unsigned BOOTSTRAP socket seats in place of the quorum (§7.10; G12 §1.2,
item 88, as at G11).
Anything citing it says "author-ratified, provisional" (§0; A17).
ADR-0033 §4, ADR-0034, ADR-0035, ADR-0037, ADR-0038, ADR-0039 A2, ADR-0041 A1, ADR-0044, ADR-0045, ADR-0047, ADR-0050 and ADR-0052 (provisional)
